notes.claim: When a coil is switched onto a supply, the current starts at zero and approaches V divided by R, with a characteristic time constant for an RL circuit.
The time constant for an RL circuit is defined as L divided by R.
The current covers 0.632 of the remainder to its final value in every time constant.
A driven damped system's general solution is a transient that depends on the starting conditions plus a steady state that depends only on the drive.
The first-order Nomoto steering model links a ship's rudder angle to its heading with two parameters, a gain K and a time constant T (added for i3: a ship answering its rudder).
For an RC circuit, the steady-state solution with a single-frequency input voltage gives the same result as the impedance method (added for i3: the sine input).
